### PE_MSQ_07: Select all cells present in Proper Connective Tissue matrix:

- [ ] A) Fibroblasts
- [ ] B) Mast cells
- [ ] C) Histocytes
- [ ] D) Osteons
- [ ] E) Plasma cells

> **✅ Answers:** A) Fibroblasts, B) Mast cells, C) Histocytes, E) Plasma cells
> **Explanation:** Proper CT matrix contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, plasma cells.

### PE_MSQ_08: Which glands release secretion via Exocytosis or Apical Pinching without total cell destruction? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Merocrine glands
- [ ] B) Apocrine glands
- [ ] C) Holocrine glands
- [ ] D) Sebaceous glands
- [ ] E) Salivary glands

> **✅ Answers:** A) Merocrine glands, B) Apocrine glands, E) Salivary glands
> **Explanation:** Merocrine (salivary) exocytoses; Apocrine pinches apex; Holocrine ruptures whole cell.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which glands release secretion via Exocy" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_MSQ_09: Select all features true for Mammalian Erythrocytes:

- [ ] A) Biconcave shape
- [ ] B) Non-nucleated at maturity
- [ ] C) Perform anaerobic respiration
- [ ] D) Contain abundant mitochondria
- [ ] E) 120-day lifespan

> **✅ Answers:** A) Biconcave shape, B) Non-nucleated at maturity, C) Perform anaerobic respiration, E) 120-day lifespan
> **Explanation:** Mammalian RBCs lack nuclei/mitochondria, undergo anaerobic respiration, live 120 days.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Select all features true for Mammalian E" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_MSQ_10: Which of the following structures contain Hyaline Cartilage? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Articular ends of long bones
- [ ] B) Nasal septum
- [ ] C) Costal cartilage of ribs
- [ ] D) Intervertebral discs
- [ ] E) Tracheal rings

> **✅ Answers:** A) Articular ends of long bones, B) Nasal septum, C) Costal cartilage of ribs, E) Tracheal rings
> **Explanation:** Hyaline cartilage lines articular ends, nasal septum, ribs, trachea. Intervertebral discs = fibrocartilage.

### PE_MSQ_11: Select all Granulocytic Leucocytes found in human blood:

- [ ] A) Neutrophils
- [ ] B) Eosinophils
- [ ] C) Basophils
- [ ] D) Lymphocytes
- [ ] E) Monocytes

> **✅ Answers:** A) Neutrophils, B) Eosinophils, C) Basophils
> **Explanation:** Granulocytes = Neutro, Eosino, Baso; Agranulocytes = Lympho, Mono.

### MSQ_P_M_08: Which statements correctly describe Cartilage matrix (Chondrin)? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Solid and pliable matrix
- [ ] B) Resists compression
- [ ] C) Contains chondrocytes in lacunae
- [ ] D) Richly vascularized with capillaries
- [ ] E) Secreted by chondroblasts

> **✅ Answers:** A) Solid and pliable matrix, B) Resists compression, C) Contains chondrocytes in lacunae, E) Secreted by chondroblasts
> **Explanation:** Cartilage matrix is solid, pliable, resists compression, avascular, secreted by chondroblasts.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Which statements correctly describe Cart" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

- [ ] A) Neutrophils
- [ ] B) Monocytes / Tissue Macrophages
- [ ] C) Basophils
- [ ] D) Eosinophils

### MSQ_P_M_10: Which structures are present in a typical Multipolar Neurone? (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Cyton (Soma)
- [ ] B) Multiple branching Dendrites
- [ ] C) Single long Axon
- [ ] D) Nissl's granules in cyton
- [ ] E) Multiple Axons

> **✅ Answers:** A) Cyton (Soma), B) Multiple branching Dendrites, C) Single long Axon, D) Nissl's granules in cyton
> **Explanation:** Multipolar neurones have 1 cyton, multiple dendrites, 1 axon, Nissl's granules.
